data.one_liner: Dart library for parsing and working with X.509 certificates.
data.what_it_does: Parses and provides utilities for working with X.509 certificates in Dart. Allows reading PEM files and inspecting certificate details.
use_when: You need to parse X.509 certificates in a Dart application
You are working with PEM-encoded certificate files
avoid_when: You need a full PKI infrastructure management system
weaknesses: Limited documentation beyond the basic usage example
